## De-vibe wave 2a — console triage (77 call sites audited, part 2 of the devibe-knip-console task)

### Why almost nothing was deleted (read this first)

Two facts about this codebase make the vast majority of the 77
`console.log`/`.debug`/`.warn` call sites in prod `src` (tests excluded)
deliberate instrumentation, not vibe-coded leftovers:

1. **`next.config.mjs`** — `compiler.removeConsole` strips `console.log`
   and `console.debug` from production builds, explicitly excluding only
   `['error', 'warn']`. Every `console.log`/`.debug` call is already a
   no-op in any deployed environment.
2. **`src/instrumentation.ts` + `src/instrumentation-client.ts`** — both
   configure `Sentry.consoleLoggingIntegration({ levels: ['log','warn','error'] })`.
   `console.warn` is the established, load-bearing structured-logging
   idiom here (forwarded to Sentry Explore → Logs) — which is exactly why
   `admin-tracer-data.ts` has an explicit comment: *"console.warn used
   (not console.log) because production build strips console.log."*

I went through every one of the 48 `console.warn` and 8 `console.debug`
call sites individually. Every single one had either an explicit comment
justifying the log level, or is a genuine production security/error
signal:

- `useAdminPresence.ts` join/leave debug logs are gated behind
  `if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production')` — literally can't fire in prod.
- `insight-delivery.ts`/`log-event/route.ts` use `console.debug` specifically
  *because* it's silent in Sentry, to downgrade known-benign transient
  errors without generating noise — documented inline.
- `pattern-miner.ts` has a full documented severity policy (info vs warn
  based on sample size) for exactly this call site.
- `admin-logger.ts`'s PGRST205 warn is deliberately once-per-session
  (`hasWarnedAdminEventsMissing` guard) with a fix-it message.
- The rest (auth rate-limiting, unauthorized message/team actions, CRM/
  insights fetch failures, localStorage failures, missing RESEND_API_KEY,
  etc.) are genuine production error/security signals — exactly the kind
  of thing `console.warn` + Sentry forwarding exists for.

None of these were leftovers. **Kept all of them, no changes.**

### Deleted (1 file, 8 statements)

`src/hooks/golf/use-service-worker.ts` — 8 `console.log` calls tracing
every SW lifecycle branch: register no-op, already-registered, registered,
unregistered, update complete, sync unsupported, sync registered, no
active worker to message, message received.

Unlike every kept call site above, these had:
- no explanatory comment,
- no dev-only guard,
- duplicate state already exposed via the hook's own return value
  (`status`/`isRegistered`/`hasUpdate`, which consumers can already
  observe reactively),
- and traced literally every branch including plain early returns.

Classic "log every branch while debugging a tricky SW bug" pattern,
never cleaned up. The 5 `console.error` calls in this same file's catch
blocks are **untouched** (KEEP per the task rule).

### Logger-idiom conversion — none performed

Grepped for a logger util first: `src/lib/admin-logger.ts`,
`server-error-logger.ts`, `error-logging.ts` exist, but none is a
general-purpose `console.warn` replacement — they're purpose-built for
the `admin_events` audit trail / Sentry error classification.
`console.warn` already **is** the repo's structured-log idiom for this
class of signal (per the `consoleLoggingIntegration` wiring above).
Converting would be redundant double-logging and risks semantic changes
(async logger calls dropped into sync catch blocks) for zero
observability gain — so warns were left as-is, per the "if none, leave
warns" instruction.

### Gates
- `npm run typecheck` — clean.
- `npx eslint --max-warnings 0 src/hooks/golf/use-service-worker.ts` — clean, zero output.
- `node scripts/check-cycles.mjs` — OK, 33 known cycles, none new.

## #373 — route crawler auth extension

**Prior state:** the file the issue's own evidence section cited (`e2e/route-crawler/route-crawler.spec.ts`) never existed. The actual artifact was `scripts/route-crawler-baseball.mjs`, a standalone Node script that POSTed JSON credentials to `${BASE_URL}/api/auth/login` — an endpoint that does not exist anywhere in this repo (only `src/app/api/golf/auth/login/route.ts` exists, and it's Golf-specific; BaseballHelm auth is a client-side Supabase form flow, not a JSON login API). So `signIn()` always failed, and `main()` exited **0** ("No baseball coach credentials — skipping authenticated crawl") regardless of whether `E2E_BASEBALL_COACH_EMAIL`/`PASSWORD` were actually configured in CI. Its "contract test" (`scripts/__tests__/route-crawler-baseball.test.mjs`) only regex-checked the source text for strings like `announcements` — it could never have caught any of this. Neither file was wired into any GitHub Actions workflow.

**What this PR does:** deletes both and replaces them with a real Playwright-based crawler.

### `e2e/baseball-route-crawler.spec.ts` (new)

Runs under the **existing** `baseball-coach` / `baseball-player` Playwright projects (see `playwright.config.ts`) — same persisted storageState auth `baseball-smoke.spec.ts` already established via `playwright/baseball-auth.setup.ts`. No new login code.

- **Discovery, not a hardcoded list:** queries the live rendered DOM for visible `<nav> a[href]` links (covers both the main sidebar — `FairwaySidebar`, `aria-label="Main navigation"` — and any hub-subnav strip, e.g. `src/app/baseball/(dashboard)/_components/hub-sub-nav.tsx`, since both are real Next `<Link>`s inside a `<nav>`). This catches a link that's registered in `nav-registry.ts` but silently fails to render — something a static source-parse (the old script's approach) structurally cannot catch.
- **Frontier crawl:** starts from Command Center (coach) / Player Today (player), then keeps discovering newly-revealed hub-subnav links as it visits each hub.
- **Public sample routes (AC bullet):** best-effort discovers any `/baseball/(player|team|program)/[id]` or `/baseball/packet/[token]` links surfaced anywhere on an authenticated page (not just `<nav>` — these are typically "share"/"view public profile" affordances), caps at 3, and re-verifies each in a **fresh, unauthenticated** browser context to confirm it renders without requiring login. Only real linked routes are probed — never guessed IDs — so this stays safe against seed-data drift and is naturally a no-op if nothing is linked.
- Writes a per-role JSON report to `test-results/baseball-route-crawler-{coach,player}-report.json`.

### `e2e/helpers/route-health.ts` (new, shared with `baseball-smoke.spec.ts`)

One `gotoAndAssessRouteHealth()` covering every failure mode the AC calls for: HTTP 4xx/5xx, guard-bounce (redirect to `/login`), wrong-sport redirect (leaving `/baseball/`, most notably into `/golf/`), a rendered React/Next error boundary, a stuck loading spinner (checked after an explicit settle), and near-blank page (very little visible body text after settling). `baseball-smoke.spec.ts` now imports `ERROR_BOUNDARY_TEXT_RE` from here instead of duplicating the regex inline — small refactor, no behavior change, single source of truth going forward.

### CI wiring

Added as its own step inside `playwright.yml`'s `e2e` job (`Run BaseballHelm authenticated route crawler (advisory)`), gated on the same `baseball-auth-ready` readiness check, plus an `Upload route crawler report` artifact step (`if: always()`, tolerant of no files).

**Deliberately NOT folded into #372's new required `ci.yml` gate.** DOM-driven visible-link discovery and the stuck-spinner/near-blank heuristics are genuinely new, unproven surface area in this codebase — no existing helper to lean on, and inherently more flake-prone than a fixed route list or a plain HTTP status check. Bundling it into an already-required gate before it's demonstrated stable would compound #372's own flake risk (noted explicitly in the original ticket research). It runs as its own isolated step in the already-advisory `e2e` job for now, with its own artifact — a failure here is visible and diagnosable without blocking any merge. Promote to a hard gate as a deliberate follow-up once it's proven clean across several `main` runs.

### Docs

`e2e/README.md` gets a new "BaseballHelm authenticated route crawler (#373)" section mirroring the existing mandatory-smoke section's style/detail level.

## Deferred / out of scope for this PR
- `docs/operations/generated/route-coverage-report.json` / `scripts/baseball/generate-route-coverage-report.ts` — these are normally regenerated against a live running app; I can't run a dev server or drive a browser locally (no browser automation on this box), so I didn't touch the generated report. Worth a follow-up once this crawler has run in CI.
- Promoting this crawler into #372's hard gate, once proven stable.

## Gate evidence
- `actionlint .github/workflows/playwright.yml` — clean.
- `npm run typecheck` (full `tsc --noEmit`) — clean (caught and fixed two real `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` issues in the new spec during review — an unguarded `.split('#')[0].split('?')[0]` chain and an unguarded indexed-array read in the frontier loop; both fixed before this evidence run).
- `npx eslint --max-warnings 0` on all touched TS files — clean.
- Confirmed via `vitest.config.ts` that the deleted `scripts/__tests__/route-crawler-baseball.test.mjs` was never wired into vitest, any npm script, or any CI workflow (grepped `.github/workflows/*.yml` + `package.json`) — deletion has zero blast radius.
- No vitest-run test helpers touched (the new/edited files are Playwright e2e specs and a Playwright-only helper, outside `vitest.config.ts`'s `unit` project globs).

Do not merge — for review. Independent of #849 (#372 + masking fix): touches a different job's steps in the same `playwright.yml` file (this PR's new step sits between the existing mandatory-smoke step and the "Run Playwright tests" step that #849 edits), so either can merge first without conflict.

## #372 — BaseballHelm authed CI smoke as hard gate

**Status before this PR:** everything except the actual gate-wiring already existed. `playwright/baseball-auth.setup.ts` fails loudly (throws) when required BaseballHelm auth secrets are missing in CI, `e2e/baseball-smoke.spec.ts` (non-skippable, `@coach`/`@player` tagged) covers Command Center, Calendar, Roster, Stats Center, Performance/Lift, Settings, plus a player→coach denied-capability redirect, and `e2e/baseball-onboarding-smoke.spec.ts` covers the anonymous onboarding-render slice. All of this ran — but only on `main` pushes / manual `workflow_dispatch`, via `playwright.yml`'s `e2e` job, which is advisory. A real authenticated regression could land on `main` before this ever ran.

**What this PR does:** adds a `baseball-auth-smoke` job directly to `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (not `playwright.yml` — jobs can only `needs:` other jobs in the same workflow file, which is why import-cycles/lint-ratchet were added directly to `ci.yml` too) that:
- Installs Playwright chromium (same cache pattern as `playwright.yml`).
- Runs `npm run build`.
- Reuses the existing "Compute BaseballHelm auth readiness" + "Fail missing BaseballHelm secrets" steps verbatim (copied, not moved — the push/manual job in `playwright.yml` is untouched and keeps running the fuller suite including mobile-viewport regression).
- Runs `npm run seed:baseball:ci`.
- Runs **only** `e2e/baseball-onboarding-smoke.spec.ts` + `e2e/baseball-smoke.spec.ts` under `--project=chromium --project=baseball-coach --project=baseball-player`, with no `|| echo` soft-fail.

Folded into `ci.yml`'s `all` aggregate `needs:` — the same promotion mechanism already used for Supabase RLS tests (#517) and the import-cycle ratchet (#808). No branch-protection/admin change needed; `CI / all` is already a required context.

### Fork/Dependabot handling

Public repo → fork PRs get no repo secrets from GitHub. The new job's `if:` only runs on `push` or on `pull_request` where `head.repo.full_name == github.repository` (i.e. not a fork). On a fork PR the job is **skipped**, not failed — `all`'s aggregate step only treats `failure`/`cancelled` as blocking, so a skip never blocks an external contribution. Same-repo pushes/PRs must have the secrets configured or the job fails loudly, same as the existing push-triggered version always has.

### Cost — please read before merging

This is a real, ongoing CI-minutes/wall-clock tradeoff, called out explicitly in the original ticket research as "should be Nick's call, not silently absorbed": it adds a **second** full `npm run build` + Playwright-chromium install to every same-repo PR, on top of the existing `Next build` and `Smoke checks` builds. The job itself is scoped tightly (2 spec files, 3 projects) and budgeted at 30 min, but it's still meaningfully more PR wall-clock time than before. Flagging so this can be revisited if PR turnaround becomes a problem — happy to scope it down (e.g. behind a path filter, or only on PRs touching `src/app/baseball/**`) as a fast follow if that's preferred.

## Also: unmask `|| echo` exit-code shim in playwright.yml (deferred review item)

`playwright.yml`'s advisory "Playwright (chromium)" job had `run: timeout 45m npx playwright test --project=chromium || echo "Playwright suite has failures or timed out — see report artifact"` — masking the exit code for the entire broad chromium suite. Reviewer-flagged on #812 as blocking trust in the e2e gate (a real failure looked identical to a clean pass in the Actions UI). Removed the `|| echo`.

**Blast radius:** this job is advisory, not a required check (`docs/CI_RUNBOOK.md` / `.github/branch-protection.md`), so unmasking it **cannot newly block a merge** — it only makes the job's own GitHub Actions status honestly reflect pass/fail. Report/results-json artifact upload steps still run regardless (`if: always()`). However: **the first red run after this merges needs a human watching** — there may be specs in the broader suite that have been silently failing under the mask for a while, and this will be the first time that surfaces. I did not attempt to identify or fix any pre-existing failures; that's follow-up work once real signal exists.

I deliberately left the other two similar `|| echo` soft-fail shims in this file (the `picker-screenshots` job's `course-library.spec.ts` run, and the advisory `baseball-smoke` job's `baseball-stats-smoke.spec.ts` run) untouched — out of scope for tonight, noting them as a follow-up if wanted.

## Docs updated
- `docs/CI_RUNBOOK.md` — `all` (CI) row now lists the new BaseballHelm authenticated smoke; added a note on the unmasked Playwright status; added the new job's wait-window + skip-is-not-a-failure notes.
- `.github/branch-protection.md` — `CI / all` hard-aggregate bullet list now includes `BaseballHelm authenticated smoke`; added a promotion note mirroring the existing #517 Supabase-RLS note.

## Gate evidence
- `actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/playwright.yml` — clean, no findings.
- `python3 -c "yaml.safe_load(...)"` on both touched workflow files — parses clean.
- No TypeScript/test-helper files touched in this PR, so typecheck/eslint/vitest gates are not applicable per the task rails.

## Deferred / not in this PR
- #373 (route crawler auth extension) is a separate PR.
- Any pre-existing Playwright failures the exit-code mask may have been hiding — first red run needs a human.
- Scoping the new `baseball-auth-smoke` job's cost down (path-filter, etc.) if the added PR wall-clock time turns out to be a problem.

Do not merge — for review.

## Task
`379-actions` — implements the **"Server actions Phase 2 (stats.ts, insights.ts, operational-signals.ts)"** chunk of the #379 stats-layer reconciliation design (`design-379.json`). Builds on Phase-0 seed work (#827) and the shared `legacy-stat-adapters.ts` module (#828), both already on `batch/bbh-finish-0714`.

## What changed, per file

**`src/app/baseball/actions/operational-signals.ts`** (the real fix)
`loadPlayerHittingSpans`'s season/career OPS baseline for the `player_cold_streak` rule read `baseball_player_stats WHERE stat_type='season'` — a value **no writer in this codebase has ever produced** (`imports.ts` / `stats.ts`'s `uploadStatsCSV` only ever write `'practice' | 'game' | 'other'`). Confirmed via `grep -rn "stat_type" ... | grep -i season` returning only that one dead query. That lookup always returned `[]`, so the cold-streak rule could never fire in production, for any team, regardless of real stat history — a live instance of the exact "seed vs. Stats Center" mismatch class #379 is about.

Fixed by routing the baseline through the shared `legacy-stat-adapters.ts` (`adaptLegacyStatsMap`), with the same precedence `roster.ts`/`roster-aggregates-merge.ts` already use for the same class of gap:
1. Prefer the canonical, box-score-era season roll-up (`baseball_player_season_stats`, written by `games.ts`'s `recalculate_baseball_season_stats()`).
2. Fall back to the legacy `baseball_player_aggregates` row's `career_ops` only when no box-score-era row exists yet for that player.
3. Neither → player excluded, no fabricated baseline.

The "recent N games" rolling window stays a direct `baseball_player_stats` read (no canonical per-game rolling-window primitive exists yet to replace it) — manifest note updated to reflect this narrower remaining scope; the file stays grandfathered.

**`src/app/baseball/actions/insights.ts`** — no code change. Tonight's #819 (`withBaseballAction` migration) already deleted `insights.ts`'s only deprecated-table references while removing dead `generateTeamInsights`/`getTeamInsights`. Confirmed via `grep` — zero references remain. Its `GRANDFATHERED_CONSUMERS` entry was **stale** (the stat-layer contract test's "no stale entries" check was red on the base branch before this PR); removed here.

**`src/app/baseball/actions/stats.ts`** — documentation only, no behavior change. `recalculatePlayerAggregates` stays a raw legacy-row calculator rather than moving behind the adapter: the adapter reconciles two *already-computed* sources for readers, it has no plug-in point for a raw-row → aggregate calculator. More importantly, `roster.ts`, `command-center.ts`, and the `player-today`/`player-snapshot-cards`/`player-passport` read-models are still direct, unmigrated consumers of `baseball_player_aggregates` per the manifest — retiring this write path now would regress those surfaces from real numbers to empty state for legacy-CSV-only teams. This matches the design's own stated alternative ("or is retired once nothing else needs a materialized `baseball_player_aggregates` row"). Added a doc comment explaining the deferral and what unblocks it.

**`src/lib/baseball/stat-layer-manifest.ts`** — removed the stale `insights.ts` entry; updated `operational-signals.ts`'s note; added the new test file's entry.

**New: `src/app/baseball/actions/__tests__/operational-signals-cold-streak.test.ts`** — exercises the real `runOperationalSignalDetection` wrapped action end-to-end (table-aware fake Supabase client, same convention as `upload-stats-csv.test.ts`). `loadPlayerHittingSpans` itself is intentionally **not** exported — every export of a `'use server'` file becomes a real, client-invokable server action, and `coverage-contract.observability.test.ts` enforces that any such export is wrapped. 3 tests cover all three precedence tiers: box-score preferred over legacy (even when legacy has stale data), legacy fallback when no box-score row exists, and no-fire when neither source has data.

Part of #379 (BaseballHelm stats-layer reconciliation) — implements the design chunk **"Migrate command-center.ts"**, building on the Phase-0 seed work (#827) and the shared `legacy-stat-adapters.ts` module (#828) already on this batch branch.

## What changed

## Summary

Nine deferred review/audit minors from tonight's batch, each re-verified against `batch/bbh-finish-0714`'s tree (not main) before touching. None were already fixed.

## Per-change notes

1. **StaffSettingsClient.tsx** — invite close-X button and role-preset chips carried a `min-h-0` className override that collapsed `Button`'s built-in 44px floor. Close-X now gets a real `min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]` (square icon button); chips just drop the override (Button's default `min-h-[44px]` applies).
2. **PhilosophySettingsClient.tsx** — the up/down reorder chevrons passed `h-8 w-8` in their `className`, overriding `size="icon-sm"`'s 44px floor down to 32px. Converted to raw `<button>` + an invisible `before:` hit-slop (`-inset-1.5`) instead of a real resize, since the shared `Button` component's ripple effect depends on `overflow-hidden`, which clips a hit-slop pseudo-element the moment it extends past the button's own box (mirrors the existing `MinimumStandards.tsx` precedent in this same batch). Widened the up/down button gap from `gap-1` to `gap-3` (12px) so the two 6px-per-side hit-slops don't overlap each other.
3. **PrivacySettingsForm.tsx** — the `h-6 w-11` toggle track (24px tall) was under the 44px floor. Same `IconButton`-overflow-hidden conflict as above; swapped to a raw `<button>` with a `-inset-2.5` hit-slop, and dropped the now-unused `IconButton` import.
4. **CampsClient.tsx** — the coach-actions row (Roster / Edit / Delete, each icon+label) had no `flex-wrap`, so it could overflow horizontally at 320px. Added `flex-wrap`.
5. **PipelineClient.tsx** / **WatchlistClient.tsx** — the commit-ceremony toast used a hardcoded `top-20`, which has no way to know whether the current hub mounts `HubSubNav` (real height varies by tab count/route) on top of the topbar. Repositioned bottom-center (mirrors the app's own `sonner` toast placement) above the mobile bottom nav via the existing `--golf-mobile-bottom-nav-offset` CSS var, and moved the hardcoded `z-50` onto the `--fw-z-toast` design-token ladder.
6. **ScoutPacketManager.tsx** — the `h-8 w-8` copy/open/revoke share-link actions were under 44px. Copy and Revoke converted to raw `<button>` (same Button-ripple conflict), Open (already a plain `<a>`) just gained the hit-slop directly. Row gap widened `gap-1` → `gap-3` to prevent the three hit-slops from overlapping each other.
7. **ProgramRoster.tsx** (public program page) — the trailing pitch/exit-velo stat blocks had no min-width floor of their own, so at 320px they and the name column fought for the same scarce space and the name lost, squeezed to a sliver. Marked the stat block `shrink-0` and hidden the two velo blocks below `sm:` — an honest omission of supplementary info rather than a silent squeeze/wrap. The chevron (fixed, tiny) stays visible at every width.
8. **StatsCenterClient.tsx** — the position filter chips' desktop height had drifted from 30px to 32px when the `[@media(pointer:coarse)]:min-h-[44px]` touch-target override was added elsewhere in the file. Reset to `min-h-[30px]` to match the original desktop height exactly (per reviewer note); the coarse-pointer 44px override is untouched.
9. **CreateAnnouncementFlow.tsx** — the sticky footer's `-mb-6` (fixed -1.5rem) under-cancels the Modal body's `pb-[max(1.5rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]` on notched phones, since the safe-area inset can exceed 1.5rem, leaving a visible gap below the bar. Now cancels the exact same `max()` expression via an arbitrary CSS property (`[margin-bottom:calc(max(1.5rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))*-1)]`), falling back to `md:-mb-6` at the breakpoint where the body reverts to a fixed `pb-6`.

## Gate evidence

- `npm run typecheck` — clean, no errors.
- `npx eslint --max-warnings 0 <all 10 touched files>` — exit 0, zero warnings/errors. New raw `<button>` usages (needed for hit-slop, per item 2/3/6 above) are each suppressed with `eslint-disable-next-line helm/no-raw-button` + an inline rationale comment, matching the existing `MinimumStandards.tsx` precedent in this batch.
- `npx vitest run` on the two contract test files that reference these components (`product-trust.contract.test.ts`, `route-shell.contract.test.ts`) — 36/36 passed. No dedicated unit tests exist for any of these 10 components in the batch tree.

## Scope

10 files changed (single PR, under the 15-file cap). No frozen files touched (`BaseballFairwayShell.tsx`, `(dashboard)/layout.tsx`, `nav-registry.ts`, living-annual barrels, `EmptyIssue.tsx` — none appear in this diff). No migrations. No destructive writes.

## Scope
SOLO ownership of `src/components/ui/select.tsx` tonight — three reviewer-routed fixes, applied to both `Select` and `MultiSelect` (the latter is unused app-wide today but shares the identical bug shape, so fixed for consistency, zero risk). Plus the requested orphaned-export cleanup in `skeleton.tsx`, plus a follow-up fix for a double-application bug the reviewer caught in the first pass.

## 1. Portal the dropdown to `document.body`
The open dropdown used to render `absolute` inside a `relative` wrapper nested under the trigger — clipped by any `overflow-hidden` card ancestor (worst on settings pages). Now it's rendered via `createPortal(..., document.body)` with:
- Position computed from the trigger's `getBoundingClientRect()` (`position: fixed`), with a viewport-aware flip (opens **upward** when there isn't room below — `origin-bottom` + reversed enter transform to match).
- Live repositioning on scroll (capture-phase, so it also tracks scrolling *inside* an ancestor card, not just the window) and resize while open.
- Outside-click detection updated to also check the portaled node (`dropdownRef`), since it's no longer a DOM descendant of the wrapper (`containerRef`) once mounted.
- Keyboard/focus behavior unchanged — Enter/Space/Arrow/Escape/Tab handlers, search-input autofocus, and highlighted-option scroll-into-view are all untouched; only where the listbox physically renders changed.

**Consumer audit**: grepped every `ui/select` import app-wide and every existing test file for `listbox`/`role="option"` assumptions or DOM-nesting/CSS-descendant-selector dependence on the old in-place structure — found none. No test or consumer assumed the dropdown rendered inside the wrapper.

## 2. Forward `className` to the outer wrapper — split by width/flex-sizing, not verbatim
Line ~160 originally hardcoded `className="w-full"` on the wrapper `<div>` and never merged the prop in — the wrapper is the actual flex item in a consumer's row layout, so even though the trigger `<button>` itself was already being correctly narrowed by `cn()`/twMerge, the *wrapper* stayed full-width, producing GamesList's "`w-28` season-year picker gets a full-width flex footprint" bug.

**Correction (this revision):** the first pass fixed that by forwarding the full incoming `className` to the wrapper verbatim (`cn('w-full', className)`), but that reintroduced a different bug — the wrapper isn't just a layout box, it also wraps the `label`/`hint`/`error` text, so any padding/background/text-size utility a consumer passed *for the trigger button's visual treatment* (DiscoverView's compact `min-h-0 px-3 py-1.5` "Sort:" select, Fairway's `fwInputCls` recipe, the CRM `inputClass`/`selectClass` helpers, `NoteCard`, `TemplatePicker`, `CalendarFeedManager`, `AutomationEditor`, etc.) leaked onto the wrapper too, adding invisible padding/background around the whole label + trigger + hint/error stack.

Fixed by splitting the caller's `className` by token instead of forwarding it whole:
- **Wrapper** gets only width/flex-sizing utilities (`w-*`, `min-w-*`, `max-w-*`, `basis-*`, `flex-*`, `grow`/`grow-*`, `shrink`/`shrink-*`, including responsive variants like `sm:w-36`) via a new `widthSizingClasses()` helper: `cn('w-full', widthSizingClasses(className))`.
- **Button** keeps the full original `className` unchanged, exactly as it always has — this is where padding/background/text-size/focus-ring utilities are supposed to land.

**Re-derived the real consumer list** (the previous audit had conflated two different Select components — see the correction below) by grepping every file that imports `Select`/`MultiSelect` from `@/components/ui/select` specifically:
- **47 files**, **87 total `<Select>`/`<MultiSelect>` JSX call sites**, **35 of which pass a `className`**.
- Verified all 35 against the split. Every one preserves its current visual result:
  - Pure width/no-visual-utility cases (`GamesList` `w-28`, `CollegesClient` `sm:w-36`/`sm:w-48`, `LiftBuilderClient` `w-48`) → wrapper picks up the width token, closing the flex-footprint bug — unchanged from the first pass.
  - Mixed width+visual cases (`JourneyClient` `w-36 shrink-0 text-sm`, `AcademicsClient` `flex-1 text-base` ×2, `BoxScoreEntry` `flex-1 max-w-xs …` and `w-20 …`, `BoxScoreUpload` `min-w-[160px] text-xs`, `TracerDataQuality` `w-auto …` ×3, `MobileEventSheet` `w-auto …`) → wrapper gets *only* the width/flex-sizing token(s); the visual utilities in the same string still land on the button (unaffected, since the button's `cn()` call was never touched).
  - Visual-only, no-width cases (`DiscoverView`'s compact `text-sm min-h-0 px-3 py-1.5` Sort select, `NoteCard`, `TemplatePicker`, `CalendarFeedManager`, `AutomationEditor` ×3, `TeamUserDirectory`, `ContactLogModal`/`ImportModal`'s `inputClass`, `CoachFilters`' `selectClass()`, Fairway's `fwInputCls`, `StatsUploadClient`'s conditional `border-primary-300`) → wrapper now gets **nothing** added (stays the plain default `w-full`); the button keeps its full visual treatment exactly as before. This is the fix for the padding/background bleed — re-checked `DiscoverView`'s compact "Sort:" select specifically, since that's the case the reviewer called out: it renders with zero extra wrapper padding now, and the trigger itself is still the same compact `min-h-0 px-3 py-1.5` button it always was.

**Correction to the previous revision's audit:** `TeamFilterControl` (`src/app/admin/activity/TeamFilterControl.tsx`) and `DocumentsFairway` (`src/components/baseball/documents/DocumentsFairway.tsx`) were incorrectly cited as consumers of this `Select` in the earlier pass. Both actually import `Select` from `@/components/fairway` — a separate component (`src/components/fairway/forms/Select.tsx`) with its own implementation, unrelated to this file. Neither is touched by, or relevant to, this PR.

## 3. 44px floor on coarse pointers
Added `[@media(pointer:coarse)]:min-h-[44px]` to the trigger, mirroring the existing `Button`/`segmented` convention (`fairway/controls/button.tsx`, `fairway/controls/segmented.tsx`). The default `min-h-[48px]` already clears 44px, but `TracerDataQuality` (×3) and `DiscoverView` pass `min-h-0` for a compact desktop toolbar look — which dropped below the WCAG 2.2 floor on touch. The coarse-pointer class carries a different Tailwind modifier than a plain `min-h-0` override, so twMerge keeps both — desktop visuals are byte-identical, only coarse pointers get the floor.

## Cleanup: orphaned `SkeletonMessages`
Deleted the unused `SkeletonMessages` export from `skeleton.tsx` (verified zero importers app-wide). Reworded the one prose comment in `messages/loading.tsx` that referenced it as a live `<SkeletonMessages />` code symbol, since it no longer exists — kept the historical "why we stopped using it" explanation, just described it in prose instead of backticked JSX.

## Tests
`src/components/ui/select.test.tsx`:
- Dropdown is a `document.body` child, not a wrapper descendant (the portal regression guard).
- Option click still fires `onChange` and still closes the dropdown.
- Outside click still closes it despite living outside the wrapper now.
- `className` forwards to the wrapper; wrapper defaults to `w-full` when absent.
- `[@media(pointer:coarse)]:min-h-[44px]` survives alongside a `min-h-0` override.
- **New**: a padding/background-bearing `className` (`text-sm min-h-0 px-3 py-1.5 bg-cream-50`) reaches the trigger button in full but does **not** reach the wrapper — the wrapper stays at its default `w-full` (the double-application regression guard).
- **New**: a `className` mixing a width/flex-sizing token with a visual one (`w-28 shrink-0 text-sm`) forwards the sizing tokens to the wrapper (not the visual one) while the button still gets everything.

## Gates
- `npm run typecheck` — clean, exit 0.
- `npx eslint --max-warnings 0 src/components/ui/select.tsx src/components/ui/select.test.tsx` — clean, exit 0.
- `npx vitest run src/components/ui/select.test.tsx` — 32/32 passed (8 cases × 4 vitest projects).
- `npx vitest run src/components/baseball/games/__tests__/GamesList.record-summary.test.tsx "src/app/baseball/(dashboard)/dashboard/performance/builder/__tests__/page.test.tsx" src/contracts/baseball/product-trust.contract.test.ts src/app/baseball/actions/__tests__/upload-box-score-csv.test.ts src/components/ui/button.test.tsx` (existing tests touching Select consumers / adjacent ui primitives) — 109 passed, 4 skipped, no regressions.

## Files touched (4, well under the 15 cap)
- `src/components/ui/select.tsx`
- `src/components/ui/select.test.tsx`
- `src/components/ui/skeleton.tsx`
- `src/app/baseball/(dashboard)/dashboard/messages/loading.tsx` (comment reword only)

No frozen files touched. No migrations. Not merging — base is `batch/bbh-finish-0714`.

## Scope
Mobile UI/UX fixer pass — `onboarding-auth` group from `mobile-findings.json` (6 findings: 5 major + 1 minor). Primitives PR #829 was already merged into `batch/bbh-finish-0714` before this branch was cut (confirmed via `git log`), so no cherry-pick was needed.

## Findings → changes

**1-2-3. Loading-state chrome drift (major)** — `forgot-password`, `reset-password`, `complete-signup`, `coach-onboarding` `loading.tsx` files all imported the generic `<PageLoading/>` → `<GenericPageSkeleton/>` (a dashboard-list skeleton) instead of mirroring their own page's chrome, the way `login/loading.tsx` and `signup/loading.tsx` already do.
- `forgot-password/loading.tsx`, `reset-password/loading.tsx`, `complete-signup/loading.tsx`: now reuse the same narrow centered `baseball-auth-field` card pattern as `login/loading.tsx`, each sized to its own page's form shape (1-input / 2-input+confirm / icon+2-up-grid).
- `coach-onboarding/loading.tsx`: rebuilt to mirror the wizard's own shell — fixed `<EntryField stage={0} variant="dawn">` scene, `HelmMark` masthead, a numbered-eyebrow progress-bar pulse, and an `EditorialFrame`-shaped double-bezel panel with stacked input-height `Skeleton` bars.

**4. `/baseball/player` triple-skeleton stack (major)** — `page.tsx`'s `authLoading` gate returned the same generic `<PageLoading/>`, stacking THREE unrelated skeleton languages (route-level flat-bars-on-`#FAF6F1`, then the dashboard-card gate, then the real EntryField+glass wizard) on the exact flow — fresh signup — where a coherent first impression matters most.
- Extracted `PlayerOnboardingSkeleton.tsx` (fixed `EntryField` + `HelmMark` + a plain pulse card standing in for the glass panel) and used it as **both** `player/loading.tsx`'s export **and** `page.tsx`'s `authLoading`-gate return, per the fixSketch. One skeleton, one look.

**5. `/baseball/join/[code]` — no loading.tsx (major)** — the player join flow runs strictly more sequential Supabase awaits than `staff/join/[code]` (which already got a bespoke `loading.tsx` specifically for this reason) yet had none, and this route is reached almost entirely via SMS/cellular invite links — the worst-case latency path.
- Added `src/app/baseball/join/[code]/loading.tsx`, copying `staff/join/[code]/loading.tsx`'s `bg-auth-baseball` + `PaperCard` skeleton verbatim (every terminal state this page renders is the same shape).

**6. NativeSelect clipping in 3-up grids (major)** — at 320-390px, `select.tsx`'s `NativeSelect` trigger (`px-4` + an inline `paddingRight: 2.5rem` for the chevron) leaves ~16px of usable text width inside a `grid-cols-3` row, clipping values like "11 in" / "UTIL" against the chevron on the "about" (Bats/Throws/2nd Pos.) and "measurables" (Height ft/in/Weight) steps.
- **Deviation from fixSketch**: the sketch's first option (a `compact` NativeSelect variant) requires editing `src/components/ui/select.tsx`, which is off-limits tonight (primitives task owns it). Took the sketch's second option instead: both rows are now `grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3`, with the 3rd field (`2nd Pos.` / `Weight`) wrapping to its own full-width row (`col-span-2 sm:col-span-1`) below `sm:`, so every visible trigger keeps a comfortable column width on phone.

**Minor (fixed — same file already being edited): StepIndicator taste/overflow gap** — player onboarding's progress bar used the shared `@/components/baseball/onboarding/StepIndicator` dot-and-connector `<nav>` (`gap-0`, no max-width/overflow guard), which can push past a 320px content budget with its widest label ("Measurables") and reads as the more generic of the two wizards' progress affordances.
- **Deviation from fixSketch**: rather than importing coach-onboarding's `_components/StepProgress.tsx` directly (that file's own header comment states it's intentionally local/non-shared to coach-onboarding), created a fresh local copy at `player/_components/StepProgress.tsx` with the same numbered-eyebrow + hairline-rule pattern, and swapped player onboarding's usage to it. Same visual result, keeps each wizard's private module boundary intact.

**Minor (fixed — file already being edited): "Forgot password?" tap target** — the link (`baseball-sign-in-form.tsx`) had no min-height, well under 44px.
- **Deviation from fixSketch**: the sketch suggested the `AuthFooterLinks` negative-margin trick (`-my-3 py-3`), but this link sits in a `flex justify-between` row directly above the password `Input` with only a 6px gap below it — a hit-slop `::before` (or unclamped negative-margin padding) sized to reach 44px would overlap the top of that `Input` and intercept its taps. Instead grew the link's own box height via real `min-h-[44px] py-2.5` padding (no negative margin), which pushes the row's total height ~24px rather than risking a touch-target collision with the adjacent input.

## Gate evidence
- `npm run typecheck` — clean (0 errors) after fixing one `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` narrowing issue introduced by the `StepProgress` swap.
- `npx eslint --max-warnings 0 <10 touched files>` — clean (0 warnings/errors).
- `npx vitest run "src/app/baseball/(onboarding)/player/__tests__/page.test.tsx" "src/app/baseball/actions/__tests__/route-shell-contract.test.ts"` — 7 test files / 61 tests, all passing (the player-onboarding wiring test + the route-shell-contract test, the only two test files referencing any touched module/route).

## Hard rails respected
- No edits under `src/components/fairway/**` or `src/components/ui/**` (both referenced read-only: `select.tsx`, `skeleton.tsx`, `loading.tsx`).
- No frozen files touched (`BaseballFairwayShell.tsx`, `(dashboard)/layout.tsx`, `nav-registry.ts`, living-annual barrels, `EmptyIssue.tsx`).
- 10 files changed, under the 15-file cap — no split needed.

## Group: settings-os

Primitives PR #829 was already merged into `batch/bbh-finish-0714` before this branch was cut (confirmed via `git log --oneline -20 origin/batch/bbh-finish-0714 | grep -i primitiv`) -- no cherry-pick was needed.

## Findings addressed

**CRITICAL -- sticky save bar behind bottom nav** (`ProgramSettingsClient.tsx`, `recruiting-preferences-client.tsx`)
Both sticky save bars used a bare `bottom-4`, which sits ~16px above the viewport edge -- squarely inside `FairwayBottomNav`'s opaque, unconditionally-rendered 56px+safe-area footprint. The only save affordance for these settings forms was invisible/untappable on mobile. Fixed by offsetting `bottom` with `--golf-mobile-bottom-nav-offset` (globals.css; zeroes out at the `md` breakpoint where there's no bottom nav to clear) -- the same idiom the Messages sticky footer already uses for this exact class of bug. `AppShell.tsx`/`FairwayBottomNav.tsx` (both under `src/components/fairway/**`, hard-rail) were **not** touched -- the fix lives entirely in the two settings client components.

**MAJOR -- Select dropdown clipped by card overflow** (`select.tsx`, `PaperCard.tsx`, `card.tsx`) -- **DEFERRED, not fixed.** The dropdown lives in `src/components/ui/select.tsx`, which is hard-rail for this task (owned by tonight's primitives task). Portaling the listbox to `document.body` is a `ui/**` change I can't make here. Flagging for the primitives owner or a follow-up task.

**MAJOR -- MinimumStandards toggle sizing** (`MinimumStandards.tsx`)
The toggle was `<Button variant="primary" className="w-6 h-6 ...">` with no `size` prop, so Button's default `md` size's `min-h-[44px]` (a different twMerge conflict group than `h-6`/`w-6`) stayed applied -- forcing a 44px-tall/24px-wide sliver with the checkmark clipped.

Diverged from the fix sketch's literal suggestion (`size="icon-sm"` + `min-h-0` override): making the box render correctly *and* meet the 44px tap-target floor via hit-slop both require `overflow-visible` on the interactive element, but Button's ripple effect is DOM-appended as a child of the button and depends on `overflow-hidden` to stay clipped to its own box -- setting `overflow-visible` on the shared `Button` here would let a 96px ripple (the `scale(4)` keyframe) bloom around what should read as a small 24x24 checkbox. Swapped to a plain native `<button>` instead (`eslint-disable-next-line helm/no-raw-button` with a reason comment, following the same escape-hatch pattern already used ~20 other places in the codebase for compact controls Button's fixed sizing can't produce), sized correctly at 24x24 with an invisible `before:-inset-3` hit-slop pseudo-element restoring the 44px tap-target floor without growing the visible box (mirrors Sheet.tsx/ModalShell.tsx's hit-slop idiom). Added `aria-pressed`/`aria-label` and a manual `triggerHaptic('light')` call so it doesn't regress on the a11y/haptic behavior the shared Button gave it for free.

**MAJOR -- hover-only metric descriptions** (`RecruitingWeightDistributor.tsx`)
Each metric's description was gated entirely behind `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave` -- permanently unreachable on touch. Per the fix sketch's first alternative, now always rendered (there was already vertical room). Removed the now-dead `hoveredMetric` state and the `group` class that had no remaining `group-hover:` consumer.

**MINOR (bundled -- already editing these files)**
- `ProgramSettingsClient.tsx`: three brand-color `<input type="color">` swatches were `h-10` (40px); bumped to `h-11` (44px).
- `recruiting-preferences-client.tsx`: the 50-state picker was one flat `flex-wrap` wall of pills. Diverged from the fix sketch's "swap to MultiSelect" alternative -- `MultiSelect` (`select.tsx`) has the *same* un-portaled `absolute` dropdown as the Select finding above, so swapping to it would just relocate the overflow-clipping bug into a component sitting inside the very `PaperCard` that clips it. Instead grouped the 50 states into US Census 4-region clusters (Northeast/Midwest/South/West -- verified exhaustive and duplicate-free against the full `STATES` list), so it reads as composed, scannable content on a phone instead of a dumped tag-cloud. `GRAD_YEARS` (8 entries) wasn't touched -- not a "wall" at that size.

**MINOR -- deferred (not in a file this PR already edits)**
- StaffSettingsClient.tsx min-h-0 overrides on close (X) button and role-preset chips.
- PhilosophySettingsClient.tsx reorder buttons shrunk to 32x32 via `h-8 w-8` override.
- PrivacySettingsForm.tsx toggle switches at 44x24 (width floor met, height under).
- Generic loading-skeleton mismatch across ~10 settings subpages (would require ~10 new files, blowing the 15-file budget on its own).
- SeasonSettingsClient.tsx / SettingsAuditClient.tsx still on the pre-SectionMasthead header treatment.

None of these live in a file this PR touches, so per the fix-minors-only-in-files-already-being-edited rule they're left for a follow-up settings-os pass.

## Gate evidence

```
$ npm run typecheck
> tsc --noEmit
(clean, no output)

$ npx eslint --max-warnings 0 <4 touched files>
(clean, no output)

$ npx vitest run <tests importing/mocking these components>
 Test Files  12 passed (12)
      Tests  100 passed (100)
```

## Files changed (4, under the 15-file cap)
- `src/components/baseball/settings/ProgramSettingsClient.tsx`
- `src/app/baseball/(dashboard)/dashboard/settings/recruiting-preferences/recruiting-preferences-client.tsx`
- `src/components/baseball/recruiting-philosophy/MinimumStandards.tsx`
- `src/components/baseball/recruiting-philosophy/RecruitingWeightDistributor.tsx`

## Scope
`player-experience` group from the mobile findings sweep (`mobile-findings.json`), 5 findings (3 major, 2 minor), all fixed. Primitives PR #829 was already on `batch/bbh-finish-0714` (`f922d910`) before this branch was cut, so no cherry-pick was needed.

## Per-finding notes

**Major — `/baseball/player/passport` batting stat grid crowds at 320-390px** (`PlayerPassportFairway.tsx`)
Base grid was `grid-cols-3` (7 batting stats) while the sibling Pitching block right below correctly used `grid-cols-2`. Followed the fixSketch's primary suggestion: changed to base `grid-cols-2` (still `sm:grid-cols-4`), matching the Pitching block so the 40px-floor `RuledStatLine` numerals get proper breathing room on a phone. Did not route through `StatStrip` (the "better" alternative in the sketch) — the one-line grid fix is lower-risk and the file is not on the touched-files list for a larger primitive migration.

**Major — `/baseball/player/timeline` AckChip tap target ~16-18px** (`PlayerTimelineFairway.tsx`)
Per the "prefer hit-slop over enlarging visuals" bar (this chip sits inline next to two other small badges — visually enlarging it to 44px would look bolted-on), added an invisible `before`-pseudo-element hit-slop (`-inset-x-1.5 -inset-y-3.5`) that expands the tappable area to ~46px without changing the visible chip. Same technique already used by `ModalShell`/`Sheet`'s close buttons and `FairwayHubSubNav` (grepped for precedent before implementing).

**Major — `/baseball/player/passport` PassportVisibilityControls FieldRow ~28px tap target** (`PassportVisibilityControls.tsx`)
Replaced the raw-button 4-option segmented radiogroup with the shared `Segmented` primitive (`@/components/fairway`) at `size="sm"` — 44px under `[@media(pointer:coarse)]`, built-in narrow-screen overflow handling. Verified its `surface-sunken`/`border-subtle` tokens are re-pointed to the Living Annual `--paper`/`--hairline` cream by the ambient `.living-annual` scope (`src/styles/baseball-living-annual.css`), so it drops in with zero bespoke styling and no visual clash. Lost the per-option hover `title` tooltip explaining the staff-only clamp (Segmented has no per-option title prop and this file must not edit `fairway/**`) — replaced with an inline `· staff-private, cannot be exposed` line under the field label, which is actually more honest on mobile since hover tooltips don't work on touch anyway.

**Minor — PassportVisibilityControls legacy cream/warm palette vs. rest of the Living Annual passport page** (`PassportVisibilityControls.tsx`, same file already being edited above)
Applied the fixSketch's "lowest-effort win": swapped `border-warm-200`→`border-[color:var(--hairline)]` and `bg-cream-50`→`bg-[var(--paper-canvas)]` on the exposure-state tiles, the read-only banner, the public-link banner, and the field-group container, plus folded `border-warm-100`/`divide-warm-100` (same structural "hairline" role) into `--hairline` too. Left `primary-*` (accent green — confirmed `primary-600` is byte-identical to `--team-ink`/`--grade-plus`, so it was never off-palette) and `text-warm-*` ink shades untouched — out of scope per the sketch, no interaction logic touched.

**Minor — `player/timeline/loading.tsx` skeleton drift** (own file)
Rebuilt on `fairwayScope('min-h-full bg-canvas')` + `--paper`/`--hairline` PaperCard-shaped event rows (bead + card, mirroring `PlayerTimelineFairway`'s actual per-event markup), replacing the legacy `bg-cream-100`/`bg-warm-100` skeleton — same fix pattern `passport/loading.tsx` already documents in its own header comment.

## Gates (worktree, no pipe-masking)
- `npm run typecheck` — clean, exit 0.
- `npx eslint --max-warnings 0` on all 4 touched files — clean, exit 0.
- `npx vitest run src/components/baseball` — 40 files / 248 tests passed, exit 0. No existing test imports these 4 presentation components directly (searched by filename, exact string, and route path), so the full baseball component suite stood in as the closest available regression check.

No changes under `src/components/fairway/**` or `src/components/ui/**` (only consumed the shared `Segmented` primitive). No frozen files touched.

## Group: coach-command (mobile UI/UX overnight fleet)

Fixes the `coach-command` findings from `mobile-findings.json`. Base already had the shared-primitives PR (#829) merged (`f922d910`) — no cherry-pick needed, verified via `git log --oneline | grep -i primitiv` before starting.

### Findings addressed

**1. CRITICAL — Signals view switcher (`Feed/Compact/Grouped/Board`) overflows and clips the Board tab off-screen at 320-430px**
`src/components/baseball/signals/SignalInboxClient.tsx`, `src/components/fairway/controls/segmented.tsx`
- **No diff needed — confirmed already resolved upstream by #829.** That PR gave `<Segmented>` its own internal `overflow-x-auto` + `useScrollFade` edge-fade, so a segment row wider than its container now scrolls in place instead of bleeding past the app's mobile `overflow-x: clip` guard.
- Verified via box-model math: the switcher's containing block here is a plain block div under `mx-auto max-w-[1400px] px-4` (no flex-row ancestor forcing it wider), so at 320px viewport the available width is 288px. `Segmented`'s root is `inline-flex max-w-full`; per the CSS2.1 shrink-to-fit formula (`min(max(min-width, available-width), preferred-width)`), its used width is capped to the 288px containing-block width regardless of the ~400px of intrinsic content — and that capped box now scrolls its own overflow (`overflow-x-auto`) rather than clipping it. The Board tab is reachable via a short in-place swipe with a visible "more this way" edge fade.
- The fixSketch's alternative (wrap in the `DocumentsFairway.tsx`-style `-mx-4 overflow-x-auto px-4` div) would be redundant on top of the primitive's own scrolling and was not applied — `src/components/fairway/**` is also off-limits per the hard rails, and no change was needed there since #829 already shipped the fix.
- `src/components/fairway/controls/segmented.tsx` untouched (fairway/** hard rail; also already fixed).

**2. MAJOR — `SignalDrillDown` hardcodes the desktop docked `side="right"` Sheet on phone**
`src/components/baseball/signals/SignalDrillDown.tsx`
- Fixed by adopting the Sheet primitive's new (#829) `mobileSide="bottom"` prop: `<Sheet side="right" mobileSide="bottom" ...>`. Below `md` it now renders as the native bottom sheet, matching Doctrine rule 4 (already applied in `FairwayNewMessageSheet.tsx` / `InsightPanel.tsx`) — without hand-rolling `useMediaQuery` (the primitive resolves it internally). Updated the file's header comment to describe the responsive behavior.
- Sibling `SourceDrawer` on the same signal card already omits `side` (defaults to bottom) and was already correct — only `SignalDrillDown` was missed.

**3. MAJOR — Command Center KPI skeleton stacks 1-column on phone, real strip renders 2x2**
`src/app/baseball/(dashboard)/dashboard/command-center/loading.tsx`
- Changed the skeleton's KPI-row wrapper from `grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 gap-y-7 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` to `grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-5 gap-y-6 sm:gap-x-8 sm:gap-y-7 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` — this is `StatStrip`'s actual `GRID_BASE[2]` + `GRID_COLS[4]` output byte-for-byte (traced `CommandCenterFairway.tsx:262` → `KPIContentsStrip` → `StatStrip` with `count=4, columns=4`, confirmed `4 < STAT_STRIP_RAIL_THRESHOLD(5)` so it takes the grid branch, not the rail branch). Loading → loaded no longer visibly reflows from a stacked column into a 2x2 grid on phone.

### Deferred (minors — not in a file already being edited for a major/critical fix)
- **StaffSettingsClient.tsx** tap-target overrides (`min-h-0` on close-X + preset pills, ~26-32px) — did not open this file; would need its own diff outside current scope.

| 2 | major | `/baseball/dashboard/stats/upload` (Match Players step) | Fuzzy-match suggestion rows were `<Button variant="primary">` with only a `hover:` override, so every unselected row rendered as a solid brand-green fill at rest. Swapped to `variant="ghost"` so only the row's own `border`/`hover` classes paint — matches the sibling disclosure toggle one level up, which already uses `ghost` correctly. |
| 3 | minor | `/baseball/dashboard/stats/upload` (Configure step) | Session Type toggle row (`Practice`/`Game`/`Other`) had no `flex-wrap`; added it so the row degrades gracefully instead of depending on exact fit at 320px. Fixed because it's in `StatsUploadClient.tsx`, already being edited for #1/#2. |

## Group: `performance-lift` (priority group — 7 criticals)

Mobile UI/UX overnight fleet. Fixes every critical + major finding assigned to this group, plus one trivial minor. Base branch has the primitives PR (#829) cherry-picked (see note below — it was still open, not yet merged into `batch/bbh-finish-0714`).

### Cherry-pick note
`git log` on `origin/batch/bbh-finish-0714` did not contain the primitives commit at task start (PR #829 was still `OPEN`). Cherry-picked `068899c4` (its head) into this branch before starting, per instructions. **That duplicate commit will disappear once #829 squash-merges** — nothing further to do on this branch's side.

---

## Findings → fixes

### Criticals

**1. Lift Lab session nav-leak (correctness bug)** — `PlayerLiftSessionClient.tsx:174,234,319`
`PlayerLiftSessionClient` had no `basePath` prop — unlike its sibling `PlayerLiftHomeClient`, which explicitly documents/implements one so shared Lift Lab components "never leak navigation into the sibling product's route tree." Three hardcoded `/lifting/dashboard/...` hrefs (BackLink, readiness-gate "Check in", post-completion "Back to Lift") meant a BaseballHelm player tapping any of them on `/baseball/dashboard/lift/[sessionId]` — the single highest-frequency mobile screen — was routed out of BaseballHelm entirely.
→ Added `basePath: string` prop, threaded from both pages (`/baseball/dashboard` and `/lifting/dashboard`), mirroring `PlayerLiftHomeClient`'s exact contract (`.replace(/\/$/, '')` + template hrefs). Added a basePath link-wiring regression test mirroring `PlayerLiftHomeClient.test.tsx`'s existing coverage pattern.

**2. Sticky "Complete lift" bar covered by bottom nav** — `PlayerLiftSessionClient.tsx:296`
`sticky bottom-0` with no z-index and no bottom clearance for `FairwayBottomNav` (fixed, opaque, `z-[var(--fw-z-nav)]=20`, ~56px+safe-area).
→ `bottom-[var(--golf-mobile-bottom-nav-offset)]` (existing shared var — zeroes at md+) + `z-[var(--fw-z-sticky)]`.

**3. Set-logging row overflow** — `PlayerLiftSessionClient.tsx:372-419`, `card.tsx:45-49,331-337`
Card's own default `padding="lg"` (p-8) wrapped everything AND CardContent's own independent p-8 stacked on top, starving the set row (needs ~300px+) down to ~130-160px on a 320-390px viewport. Per the fixSketch, this is a **call-site-only fix** — no `ui/card.tsx` edit (hard rail respected): `padding="none"` on the outer `<Card>` + explicit `p-4 md:p-6` on Header/Content. Rebuilt the row itself: label + Log button on one line, reps/load/RPE as a `grid-cols-3` below — removes the fixed w-16 inputs needing an unbroken ~300px row regardless of the padding math. Also removed the `min-h-0` tap-target overrides on the three inputs (THE BAR: prefer removing overrides over enlarging visuals) — they now fall back to `Input`'s own 48px floor.

**4. Live Weight Room split pane** — `LiveWeightRoomClient.tsx:293,368,461-462`
Hardcoded `h-screen flex` with a permanent `w-80` athlete-detail `<aside>` — alone met/exceeded a 320-430px viewport, clipping the set-logging drawer.
→ Swapped the aside for the shared Fairway `Sheet` (`side="right" mobileSide="bottom"` — the primitive built for exactly this) so it portals out of the flex layout entirely instead of competing for width. Swapped `h-screen` for `h-[calc(100dvh-var(--golf-mobile-header-offset)-var(--golf-mobile-bottom-nav-offset))]`, the same shell-aware idiom `ConversationClient.tsx` (#481) already established, instead of assuming the component owns the full viewport.

**5. Program Editor split pane** — `ProgramEditorClient.tsx:662,664,94`
Permanent `w-72` week/day rail, unconditional, squeezing the day-editor pane to near-zero width below 390px.
→ Added the same mobile tab-switcher `LiftCanvas` already uses one level up in this vertical (segmented "Weeks & days" / "Day editor", `lg:` breakpoint to match). Selecting/adding/duplicating a day auto-jumps to the editor tab. Also wrapped the now-full-width prescriptions `<table>` in `overflow-x-auto` — without it, the pane would just overflow on its own content instead of the aside's. Skeleton updated to match.

**6. Strength Groups split pane** — `StrengthGroupsClient.tsx:53,55,312`
Identical pattern to #5 (permanent `w-64` rail). Same fix family: mobile tab-switcher ("Groups" / "Members"), `overflow-x-auto` on the members table, skeleton updated.

**7. Lift Builder Save bar covered by bottom nav** — `LiftBuilderClient.tsx:482`
`z-10` (below the nav's `z-20`) + a bare safe-area offset that never subtracted the nav's actual 56px height.
→ Same fix as #2: `bottom-[calc(var(--golf-mobile-bottom-nav-offset)+1rem)]` + `z-[var(--fw-z-sticky)]`.

### Majors

**8. Today Weight Room board forced horizontal scroll** — `PerformanceCommandCenter.tsx:150-189,485-493`
`min-w-[560px]` + `overflow-x-auto` wrapper around `WeightRoomRow`, which already stacks itself (`flex-col ... sm:flex-row`) — solving a problem that no longer existed post-refactor. Dropped the wrapper.

**9. LiftCanvas block-reorder buttons off-screen** — `LiftCanvas.tsx:792-816`
`absolute -left-8` unconditionally, pushed past the 16px mobile gutter. Kept that treatment `lg:flex`-only; `SessionBlock` now renders its own inline up/down chevrons in the block header, `lg:hidden`.

**10. Programs list header overflow** — `ProgramListClient.tsx:243-256`
Fixed `w-60` search input + CTA with no wrap, exceeding a 320-375px viewport. Input now shrinks via `flex-1 min-w-0`, CTA pinned via `shrink-0`, `flex-wrap` as the last-resort fallback.

### Minor (fixed — trivial given the shipped primitives)

**11. ExerciseWizard modal not a bottom sheet** — `ExerciseWizard.tsx:308-313`
Added `sheetOnMobile` to the `<Modal>` call — the primitives PR built this exact opt-in for this exact case, so it was a one-line fix once available.

### Deferred

**12. LiftBuilderClient/LiftCanvas DetailPane Living-Annual re-skin (minor)** — a visual redesign task (legacy Tailwind tokens → `SectionMasthead`/`Eyebrow`/`font-annual`). Deferred: real visual risk without browser verification (NO browsers/Playwright rail), and both files are already large diffs in this PR from the other fixes above. Left for a follow-up pass with visual review.

```
npx vitest run <new test + every test importing a touched component>

```

## Summary

Overnight mobile UI/UX audit fixes for the **development** finding group (practice planner / scrimmage builder / dev plans / compare & comparisons). 6 findings fixed: 2 critical, 3 major, 1 minor.

Cherry-picked primitives PR #829 (`068899c`) onto this branch since it was not yet merged into `batch/bbh-finish-0714` at task start (still open). The duplicate commit will disappear on squash-merge of this PR onto the batch branch once #829 lands first.

## Findings → what changed

**1. `/baseball/dashboard/practice` — critical — no usable touch method to move/resize a practice block**
`TimeRailBuilder.tsx` + `PracticePlannerClient.tsx`. The rail's drag handle (~14px `GripVertical`) and resize strip (`h-2`, 8px) are far under the 44px floor, and the documented "accessible alternative" (focus + ArrowUp/Down) can't actually be reached from a touchscreen — a focused div doesn't raise a soft keyboard or let a finger fire arrow keys. Per the task brief's explicit direction ("implement the accessible tap-based fallback... rather than attempting drag gestures"), added **Start / Duration +/-5min steppers** to the Block-details card (which already opens on tap) wired through the exact same `updateBlock` path the rail itself uses. `RAIL_STEP`, `MIN_DURATION`, and `fmtClock` are now exported from `TimeRailBuilder.tsx` so both surfaces share one source of truth instead of a second copy of the same constants that could drift. Left the drag/keyboard code paths themselves untouched (out of scope per the brief).

**2. `/baseball/dashboard/compare` — critical — PlayerComparison footer can render/clip outside the visible card**
`features/player-comparison.tsx`. The footer (`Comparing N players` + Export PDF + Save Comparison, all `whitespace-nowrap`) had no wrap/stack fallback, and the ancestor `Card` uses `overflow-clip` — so under ~390px the overflow wasn't a scrollbar, it silently hid whichever button lost the space fight (`Save Comparison`, the primary action). Footer now stacks (`flex-col` → `sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between`) with `flex-wrap` on the button row, so both actions always render fully on-screen.

**3. `/baseball/dashboard/practice` — major — ScrimmageLineupBuilder touch targets under 44px**
`ScrimmageLineupBuilder.tsx`. Native HTML5 drag-and-drop doesn't fire on touchscreens, so the field-position slot button and the bench/bullpen "Remove" (X) button are the *only* tap mechanism to place/remove a player — but both overrode Button's `min-h-[44px]` floor with `min-h-0`. Dropped the override on the slot button (inherits the floor). For the remove button, grew it to a real 44×44 box (`min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2`) rather than an invisible hit-slop pseudo-element — deviated from THE BAR's stated hit-slop preference here because list rows sit only `space-y-1` (4px) apart, so an oversized `::before` hit area would silently steal taps meant for the neighboring row's own remove button. Also added `min-w-0 flex-1` to the player-name span so it truncates cleanly instead of getting squeezed by the now-wider button.

**4. `/baseball/dashboard/dev-plans` — major — CreateDevPlanModal not keyboard-safe, cramped picker**
`coach/CreateDevPlanModal.tsx`. Hand-rolled centered dialog sized with static `vh` and a hard `grid-cols-2` roster picker; when the on-screen keyboard opens for Title/Description/Goal fields, the vertically-centered `90vh` card doesn't reflow and the "Create Plan" CTA can end up pinned behind the keyboard. Switched to bottom-anchored-on-phone (`items-end` → `sm:items-center`) with a `dvh`-safe max-height (centered dialog unchanged at `sm:`+), `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2` on the player picker, and safe-area-aware footer padding now that the card sits flush to the screen edge on phone.
Deviation from the fixSketch's *primary* suggestion: I did **not** re-platform this onto the shared `Modal`'s new `sheetOnMobile` prop, even though that's the intended primitive for exactly this class of bug. This environment has no browser/Playwright and no `next build/dev`, so a full re-platform of a working (if buggy) hand-rolled modal is unverifiable risk. I applied the fixSketch's own explicitly-provided "at minimum" fallback instead (grid + dvh + bottom-anchor + safe-area footer), which is a self-contained, easily-reasoned-about diff.

**5. `/baseball/dashboard/compare` — major — Add Players search squeezed by selected-player chips**
`CompareClient.tsx`. Search box and the selected-player-chip row sat side-by-side (`flex items-start gap-4`) with no stacking breakpoint and no `min-w-0` — the moment a coach adds a 2nd/3rd player, the chip column and search fight for the same ~250-290px, and the search input (missing `min-w-0`) can't actually shrink. Now `flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-start` with `min-w-0` on the search wrapper.

**6. `/baseball/dashboard/comparisons` — minor — SavedComparisonsList is the one un-migrated sibling**
`features/saved-comparisons-list.tsx`. dev-plans/compare/practice are all on the Living Annual kit; this list still rendered a plain `Card` + hand-rolled empty-state circle. Ported onto `PaperCard` (dropping the extra padding wrapper div) and `<EmptyIssue variant="generic" ink="pursuit" />` (matching `PracticePlannerClient`'s own usage — no dedicated "comparisons" preset exists in `EMPTY_ISSUE_PRESETS`, and that file is frozen so one couldn't be added), and swapped `warm-*` text tones for `text-text-*` / `--hairline` / `grade-plus` ink tokens.

## Hard rails observed
- No edits under `src/components/fairway/**` or `src/components/ui/**` — used `PaperCard`, `EmptyIssue`, `StatReadout`, `Button` from those trees as consumers only.
- No frozen files touched (`BaseballFairwayShell.tsx`, `(dashboard)/layout.tsx`, `nav-registry.ts`, living-annual barrels, `EmptyIssue.tsx` — all imported-from, not edited).
- 7 files touched, well under the 15-file cap.

## Gates (run in the worktree, no pipe-masking)
- `npm run typecheck` → clean (exit 0)
- `npx eslint --max-warnings 0` on all 7 touched files → clean (exit 0)
- `npx vitest run` on `CreateDevPlanModal.test.tsx`, `dev-plans-coach-gating.test.ts`, `practice-validation.test.ts` (the tests that exist for/near touched components) → **92/92 passed** across 12 test files (shared setup pulls in siblings)
- No test file directly imports `ScrimmageLineupBuilder`, `player-comparison`, `saved-comparisons-list`, or `CompareClient` (confirmed via repo-wide grep) — none to run for those.

Not merging — leaving for review per instructions.

## Group: team-ops (mobile audit)

Fixes all 8 `team-ops` findings from the mobile audit (1 critical, 3 major, 4 minor). Base includes a cherry-pick of the primitives PR (#829, head `068899c`) since it wasn't merged into `batch/bbh-finish-0714` yet at task start — see note at bottom.

### Critical

**DocumentCard.tsx — kebab menu + footer actions invisible on touch** (`/baseball/dashboard/documents`)
The kebab "More options" trigger and the footer Preview/Download row were both `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100` — no `:hover` on a touchscreen means these were permanently invisible, so a coach could only ever reach Preview via the card's own onClick.
- What changed: both now render `opacity-100` by default, gated to hover-only at `md:` (`md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:focus-within:opacity-100`).
- The footer Preview `IconButton` also had a `w-auto h-auto` override shrinking it well under the 44px floor — removed so it falls back to the shared `IconButton` default (44×44).
- The Download `<a>` isn't a shared primitive and has no `overflow-hidden` ancestor, so it gets a proper hit-slop pseudo-element (`before:absolute before:-inset-2.5`) instead — same technique as `ModalShell`'s close button, visual icon unchanged.

### Major

**ScrimmageLineupBuilder.tsx — sub-44px tap targets on the lineup-build flow** (`/baseball/dashboard/practice`)
Team Blue/White toggle, roster-row select buttons, and the bench/bullpen remove (X) button all explicitly overrode the shared `Button`'s `min-h-[44px]` floor with `min-h-0`.
- Toggle + roster rows: removed `min-h-0` so the `Button` primitive's own 44px floor is restored (compact `px-*`/`py-*`/`text-xs` visual untouched).
- Bench/bullpen remove: was `min-h-0 p-0` around a bare 12px icon (~16px hit area) with no other floor to fall back to — gave it an explicit `min-h-11 min-w-11 p-0` (44×44 box, same 12px icon, no visual growth on the icon itself).

**PracticeEffectivenessClient.tsx — filter tabs under 44px** (`/baseball/dashboard/practice-effectiveness`)
The All/Measured/Attention/Need-data tabs render via `size="sm"` `Button` with `min-h-0` overriding the accessible floor (~20px actual height on the page's primary nav).
- Removed `min-h-0` from the tab className. Went with the fixSketch's simpler "or" branch (vs. swapping to the shared `Segmented` control) — same 44px outcome, lower risk/diff for a control that already has working `role="tab"`/`aria-selected` semantics.

**roster/loading.tsx — desktop-shaped skeleton on a phone** (`/baseball/dashboard/roster`)
The roster-wall skeleton was unconditionally the desktop 5-column `overflow-x-auto` + `min-w-[680px]` table shape, while the real `RosterWall` (`RosterFairway.tsx`) renders full-width stacked rows below `md` with no horizontal scroll.
- Added a `md:hidden` stacked skeleton (avatar/name plate + 2 stat pills + a `44×44` row-menu box, no `min-width`/`overflow-x-auto`) that mirrors `RosterWall`'s actual mobile branch (`flex flex-col md:hidden`).
- Wrapped the existing 680px table skeleton in `hidden md:block` so desktop is unchanged.

### Minor

**documents-client.tsx + TravelClient.tsx — native `window.confirm(...)` on destructive actions** (`/baseball/dashboard/documents`, `/baseball/dashboard/travel`)
Both delete flows popped the unstyled OS `confirm()` dialog instead of the app's own pattern.
- Swapped both for the shared `ConfirmDialog` (`variant="danger"`, native bottom-sheet on-device) — same treatment as `SavedLineupsPanel`/`RosterMemberActions` elsewhere in the hub.

**TravelClient.tsx — full-page reload after Create/Edit Trip** (`/baseball/dashboard/travel`)
`handleSaved` called `window.location.reload()` — white-flash + lost scroll position on mobile.
- Swapped for `router.refresh()`.
- **Fix-sketch deviation**: `TravelClient` copies its `itineraries` prop into local `useState(initialItineraries)`, which does *not* re-seed on a bare `router.refresh()` — `useState`'s initializer only runs once, so the newly created/edited trip would silently never appear post-refresh (a correctness regression the fixSketch didn't anticipate). Added a `useEffect` that re-syncs local state whenever the server-refreshed prop changes, so the fix actually delivers fresh data instead of just removing the reload.

**PopoverPanel.Item under-target roster kebab menu items** (`/baseball/dashboard/roster`)
Already resolved by the primitives PR — `min-h-11` confirmed in `PopoverPanel.tsx` after the cherry-pick below. No change needed in `RosterMemberActions.tsx`; `PopoverPanel.tsx` itself is out of scope (`src/components/fairway/**`, the primitives task's file).

**PracticeRecapPanel.tsx — unconditional `grid-cols-3` scoring row** (`/baseball/dashboard/practice`)
Blue/White/Innings score inputs squeezed into ~80px columns at 320px with no mobile stacking, inconsistent with the panel's other stat grid two sections up.
- Changed to `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3` so the three fields stack on phone.

### Primitives cherry-pick

Primitives PR #829 wasn't merged into `batch/bbh-finish-0714` at task start (`git log --oneline -20 | grep -i primitiv` came back empty). Cherry-picked its head commit (`068899c4`) onto this branch cleanly before starting — that commit will disappear as a duplicate once #829 merges and this branch is rebased/squash-merged.

### Gates (worktree, no pipe-masking)

- `npx vitest run src/components/baseball/practice-planner/__tests__/PracticeRecapPanel.test.tsx` — 4/4 passed (only test file found that imports a touched component; action-level tests for documents/travel/practice-effectiveness import the server actions, not these client files)

7 files changed, well under the 15-file cap. No edits under `src/components/fairway/**` or `src/components/ui/**` (used their exported components — `ConfirmDialog`, `IconButton`, `Button` — unmodified).

## Group: messages-hub (mobile audit)

Fixes 5 of 6 `messages-hub` findings from the overnight mobile audit; 1 minor deferred (see below). All findings verified against current code before fixing — two of the six turned out to already be substantially fixed on this base branch by prior #481/#817 work; those are noted.

### Cherry-pick note
PR #829 (shared primitives) was still **open** (not merged) at the start of this run. Cherry-picked its head commit (`837b6f02`) onto this branch first, for `Modal`'s new `sheetOnMobile` prop. **The duplicate commit will disappear once #829 squash-merges into the base branch and this branch is rebased/merged after it** — no action needed unless #829 lands with unexpected conflicts.

---

### Finding → fix

**1. [critical] `/messages` loading.tsx renders a hardcoded, non-responsive desktop skeleton**
`messages/loading.tsx` used the generic `<SkeletonMessages />` — a fixed `w-80` + `flex-1` two-column shape with its own `bg-white`/`rounded-2xl` chrome, overflowing a 320px phone by ~48px and flashing to a completely different shape on hydrate. Per the fixSketch's preferred option: swapped in `<MessagesFairway loading mobileShowChat={false} listSlot={null} chatSlot={null} modalSlot={null} />` — the exact fallback `MessagesClient`'s own internal `<Suspense>` already uses, so there is now exactly one skeleton shape for this route (list column full-width on phone / `lg:w-80` at desktop, chat pane `hidden` below `lg`) instead of two that can drift apart.

**2. [critical] HubSubNav height not accounted for → composer clipped**
Investigation found `MessagesFairway.tsx`'s `SHELL` constant and `ConversationClient.tsx`'s height box **already** subtract `--baseball-hub-subnav-offset` (a real ResizeObserver-published var from `hub-sub-nav.tsx`) — this was fixed on the base branch by commit `ede014cc` ("Messages viewport math clips composer behind bottom nav (#481) (#817)") before this task started. The one residual gap: `ConversationClient`'s composer `<form>` was missing the safe-area bottom padding `MessagesClient`'s own composer already carries. Added `pb-[calc(1rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] lg:pb-4` to match, so both composers get identical breathing room above the home indicator.

**3. [major] NewMessageModal search results render as solid green pills**
Each result row was `<Button variant="primary">`, which unconditionally sets `bg-primary-600 text-white` — every unselected contact in the list rendered as a filled accent-green button regardless of hover/selected state. Switched to `variant="ghost"` (no unconditional background) — the existing `hover:bg-warm-50` / selected `bg-primary-50` classNames are untouched and still win via `twMerge`.

**4. [major] UrgencyPicker grid-cols-4 wraps text character-by-character on phone**
`grid grid-cols-4` had no responsive override; at 320-430px each of the 4 cells (dot + label + description) had only ~30-57px of usable width, wrapping every word. Changed to `grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4` so each phone cell gets roughly double the room, matching the pattern already used elsewhere in this codebase for compact multi-option pickers.

**5. [minor] Compose modals read as shrunk-desktop dialogs, static-vh trap**
Added the new `sheetOnMobile` prop (from the cherry-picked primitives PR) to both `NewMessageModal`'s and `CreateAnnouncementFlow`'s `<Modal>` — they now render as bottom sheets (rounded top corners, drag bar, safe-area padding) below `md`, centered dialog unchanged at `md`+. This also resolves the `100vh` vs `100dvh` trap named in the finding for free, since `sheetOnMobile`'s branch already uses the dvh-safe `max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)]`.

**6. [minor] ConversationClient vs MessagesClient render two unrelated designs for the same conversation — DEFERRED**
The fixSketch's preferred option (retire `/messages/[id]`, redirect deep links to `/baseball/dashboard/messages?conversation=<id>`, matching golf's existing pattern) is the right long-term fix — `MessagesClient` already supports `?conversation=` — but doing it properly here would mean:
- Updating 3 deep-link call sites (`NotificationBell.tsx`, `PlayerDetailModal.tsx`, `lib/notifications/index.ts`) — outside this finding's listed files.
- Retiring/deleting `ConversationClient.tsx` and its dedicated `[id]/loading.tsx`, both of which carry deliberate, recently-added (#481) height-parity fixes with their own detailed reasoning comments — not neglected debt.
- Touching route-manifest/test-registry files (`nav-manifest.test.ts`, `baseball-route-inventory.ts`) that reference the route, which sit adjacent to the frozen `nav-registry.ts`.

That's a disproportionate blast radius for a minor finding inside a 5-file PR. Flagging for a follow-up task with its own scoped PR rather than doing a partial/risky version here.
