## Summary

W21 — opens the engine rewrite block (W21-W25). Adds the `engine_version` column, the abstract `BaseGenerator` class, the v3 upsert wrapper, and the first concrete v3 generator (`PuttDistanceGenerator`).

## Migrations

| File | Effect |
|---|---|
| `20260525180000_v3_engine_version_on_insights.sql` | `ADD COLUMN engine_version text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'v2'` + CHECK constraint. 266 existing prod rows correctly defaulted to `'v2'` on apply. |
| `20260525180100_v3_engine_version_index.sql` | `CREATE INDEX (engine_version, created_at DESC)` — split per Rule 2. |

Both applied to prod, verified live.

## TS architecture

```
src/lib/coachhelm/v3/
├── engine/
│   ├── types.ts          GeneratorAggregate / RunResult / ComposedContent
│   └── generator-base.ts abstract BaseGenerator
├── insights/
│   └── upsert-v3.ts      wraps v2 upsertInsight + stamps engine_version='v3'
└── generators/
    └── putt-distance.ts  first concrete generator (3 buckets)
```

`BaseGenerator.run()` orchestrates the full lifecycle automatically:
1. `aggregate()` (subclass)
2. min-sample-N gate
3. load v3 standing — skip if missing
4. `composeContent()` (subclass)
5. compute counterfactual (auto-suppressed under 0.3 strokes)
6. inject `evidence.standing` + `evidence.counterfactual`
7. `upsertInsightV3` (v3: prefix, engine_version='v3' stamp)

Concrete generators only implement aggregate + composeContent; everything else is shared.

## Coexistence safety

Both engines write to `golf_coach_insights`:
- v2 → `engine_version='v2'`, plain signatures
- v3 → `engine_version='v3'`, `v3:` prefixed signatures

Different signature space → no dedup collisions during W21-W25 window. W35 outcome attribution can compare v3-vs-v2 lift directly.

## Rule 1 preserved

`v2/insights/upsert.ts` is NOT modified. `upsertInsightV3` wraps it as a thin layer — call v2 upsertInsight, then UPDATE to stamp engine_version. One extra UPDATE per insert is acceptable (cron paths, not user-blocking).

## Tests

`src/test/coachhelm/v3/PuttDistanceGenerator.test.ts` — **5/5 passing**:
- identity (name, insightType, category, minSampleN)
- bucket → metricId mapping for all 3 buckets
- compose: title/content/signature for 10-15 ft
- compose: evidence shape (canonical metric_id + comparison_source='pga_baseline')

End-to-end orchestrator test belongs to W25 (cutover).

## Not invoked yet

PuttDistanceGenerator exists as a buildable + testable unit. The v2 orchestrator still emits putt-distance insights via v2 mining/. **W25 is the cutover wave that swaps the orchestrator to call v3 generators.** W22-W24 build out the remaining 8 v3 generators first.

| `3-6ft make %` | `putts_made_3_5ft_pct` |
| `Avg proximity 80-120y` | `approach_proximity_50_125ft` |
| `avg_proximity_ft` | `approach_proximity_50_125ft` |
| `make_pct_5_10` | `putts_made_5_10ft_pct` |
| `scrambling_pct` | `scrambling_pct_rough` |
| `Bounce-back %` | **SKIPPED** — no v3 equivalent |
| `Fairways hit %` | **SKIPPED** — no v3 fw% metric |

Skipping is preferable to minting goals against the wrong metric.

## Plan deviation: NO rename of focus_areas table

Master plan Part VI.6 SQL ends with `ALTER TABLE golf_player_focus_areas RENAME TO _deprecated_...`. That would break `/dashboard/my-development` which still reads focus_areas. **The rename is deferred** to a future wave that ships after `/my-development` migrates to read from goals. Both tables coexist meantime; new code reads goals, legacy page keeps reading focus_areas.

## Migration semantics

- `created_by_user_id`: resolved from `coach_id → golf_coaches.user_id`, falling back to player's user_id if coach was orphaned. NULLs skipped (NOT NULL constraint).
- `creator_role`: `'coach'` when coach_user_id resolved, else `'player'`.
- `started_at` / `ends_at`: defaults to focus_area.started_at + 90 days if no completed_at; clamped to the schema's 7-365 day CHECK.
- `baseline_value` = `current_value` (today's snapshot — we don't have historical baseline).
- `shared_with_coach` = `true` for coach-assigned (continuity with focus-area semantics).
- `coach_assignment_mode` = `'mandatory'` for coach-assigned (pre-existing focus areas were effectively mandatory).
- `status` mapping: `completed → achieved`, `active → active`, anything else → `abandoned`.

## Idempotency

Wrapped in `DO $$ ... IF (SELECT count(*) FROM golf_goals) > 0 THEN RETURN; ... END $$`. Re-running the migration is a no-op once any goals exist.

coach_assigned     : 5
mandatory          : 5
metrics_covered    : 4   (avg_proximity_ft + 80-120y both map to approach_proximity_50_125ft)

| **NEW** `.../counterfactual/lookup-tables.ts` | Per-metric stroke-impact-per-unit + coachable-timeframe-weeks. Sourced to Research doc §3-4 + §10. |
| **NEW** `.../counterfactual/compute.ts` | Pure `computeCounterfactual()` + `formatCounterfactualLine()`. 4 suppress reasons. |
| **NEW** `.../counterfactual/baseline-loader.ts` | `loadPlayerScoringBaseline()` from cache; null when <5 rounds. |

| **NEW** `src/test/golf/components/Counterfactual.test.tsx` | **14 tests** — all 4 suppress reasons + format spec + lower_better direction + component render. |

## Suppression logic (Part X discipline)

| Reason | Trigger |
|---|---|
| `unknown_metric` | metric_id not in COUNTERFACTUAL_LOOKUP |
| `no_gap` | player_value is at or past PGA (no upside) |
| `below_threshold` | computed strokes_saved < 0.3 (stat noise) |
| `no_baseline` | player has no scoring_average (< 5 rounds in cache) |

Suppression returns `suppressed: true` + reason. CounterfactualLine returns null in all suppressed cases.

## Sample output

`Closing this gap → 75.2 → 74.5 (≈4 wks)` — italic, light weight, beneath the StandingBar. Singular "wk" for 1-week timeframes.

## EvidencePanel integration deferred

EvidencePanel is synchronous and doesn't have access to the player's baseline scoring avg. Wiring it up requires the upstream surface (InsightCard parent, InsightsFeed) to fetch baseline once and pass via prop. Doable but cross-cutting — landing as a follow-up when the next coach-surface wave touches those files. **`/my-standing` users get the counterfactual line now; coach insight cards get it in a follow-up.**

- 14/14 new tests pass
- Full suite: 974 passing, 44 skipped, 8 pre-existing failures (unrelated)

## Lookup-table caveat

The `stroke_impact_per_unit` values in `lookup-tables.ts` are educated estimates from the Research doc, not measured per-player. The whole point of W35 (outcome attribution) is to feed back which projections actually came true so these factors can be refined. For now, treat the displayed weeks/strokes as "directionally correct, magnitude tunable."

W11 — the standing computation pipeline. Every (player, metric) pair gets a snapshot of `player_value + team_avg + team_pct + pga_value + pga_delta`, computed nightly by an in-DB RPC the cron route calls.

**Stacks 5 deep behind PRs #41 → #42 → #43 → #44.** Cannot ship to prod until W9-pt2 (`golf_metrics`) and W10 (`golf_pga_standards`) land first — both are FK targets.

## Headline result from the prod dry-run

`BEGIN; <full W9-pt2 + W10 + W11 chain>; SELECT * FROM refresh_player_standing(<5 real team UUIDs>); <verify>; ROLLBACK;`:

```
total_standing_rows : 171   (real upserts; nothing persisted)
distinct_metrics    : 15    (every covered metric produced rows)
distinct_players    : 14    (players with rounds_played >= 5)
rpc_exists          : 1
```

The RPC actually populates real data — this isn't a stub.

## Migration count: 1 → 2 (Rule 2 split — table separate from RPC)

Plan Part XXIII said 1 migration; Rule 2 forced a split. Plan amended in this PR to `C:5, M:0, 2 migrations`.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `supabase/migrations/20260524210000_v3_golf_player_standing_table.sql` | `CREATE TABLE` with composite PK `(player_id, metric_id)`, FKs to `golf_players` + `golf_metrics`, 2 indexes, RLS (player-own + coach-team via `is_team_coach`). |
| `supabase/migrations/20260524210100_v3_refresh_player_standing_function.sql` | `refresh_player_standing(p_team_ids uuid[])` SECURITY DEFINER PL/pgSQL. Loops 15 trusted bindings, runs PERCENT_RANK upsert via EXECUTE per metric. Returns `(metric_id, rows_upserted)` per row. |
| `src/lib/coachhelm/v3/standing/types.ts` | `PlayerStanding` interface + `hasTeamMarker()` cold-start helper. |
| `src/lib/coachhelm/v3/standing/loader.ts` | `loadStandingForMetric(playerId, metricId)` + `loadPlayerStandingMap(playerId)`. |
| `src/lib/coachhelm/v3/standing/refresh.ts` | `STANDING_REFRESH_METRIC_IDS` (15) + `STANDING_REFRESH_DEFERRED_METRIC_IDS` (13) + chunk size + min rounds. |
| `src/app/api/cron/v3/standing-refresh/route.ts` | GET/POST cron route. `requireCronAuth` (Bearer `CRON_SECRET`). Picks 50 teams, calls RPC, returns `RefreshSummary`. |

## Metric coverage in V1

**Covered (15) — directly readable from `golf_player_stats_cache`:**
- SG cluster (5): `sg_total`, `sg_ott`, `sg_approach`, `sg_around_green`, `sg_putting`
- Putt make % (3): `putts_made_{3_5,5_10,10_15}ft_pct`
- `gir_pct`, `scrambling_pct_sand`
- Course mgmt (2): `penalty_rate_per_round`, `big_number_rate` (computed from doubles+triples)
- Per-par (3): `scoring_par_{3,4,5}`

**Deferred to W21+ generators (13):**
- `putts_made_15_25ft_pct`, `putts_made_25_plus_ft_pct` — cache buckets are 15-20 + 20+, not 15-25 + 25+. Tracked as a follow-up: either amend v3 metric IDs to align with cache, or add new cache columns.
- `putt_miss_bias_{high,low,left,right}_pct` — no public benchmark + no cache column. W22 `PuttBiasGenerator` will compute from shots.
- `approach_proximity_{50_125,125_175,175_plus}ft` — cache only has overall `approach_proximity_average`. W22 `ApproachMissGenerator` handles buckets.
- `scrambling_pct_{rough,fairway}` — cache lacks lie split.
- `practice_tournament_delta`, `opening_hole_delta` — need round-level computation (W24).

## Safety: SECURITY DEFINER and EXECUTE

The RPC uses dynamic SQL (`EXECUTE format(...)`) but **every interpolated fragment comes from the function body's hard-coded `v_bindings` array**, NOT from caller input. Caller passes only `p_team_ids uuid[]` (typed) and the loop selects which binding to run. The metric_id is passed as a SQL parameter (`$2`), not interpolated. No injection surface.

## Operational follow-ups (NOT in this PR)

1. Add the Vercel cron schedule (`vercel.json`) once preview soak confirms the route is healthy.
2. After W9-pt2 + W10 land, regenerate `src/lib/types/database.ts` so the cron route's `(supabase as any).rpc(...)` cast can be retired.
3. W12 ships the one-shot historical backfill in a separate PR.
4. CI parity check between `STANDING_REFRESH_METRIC_IDS` (TS) and the function's `v_bindings` (SQL) is a small follow-up.

- [ ] Reviewer agrees with the 15/13 coverage split for V1.
- [ ] Reviewer confirms the SECURITY DEFINER + EXECUTE pattern (no caller input in dynamic SQL).
- [ ] Reviewer confirms the percentile direction inversion (`lower_better` → DESC) is correct — `team_pct = 100` should always mean "best on the team."
- [ ] Reviewer signs off on shipping the cron route without the Vercel schedule (soak in preview first).

W9 sub-batch 3 of 3 — final foundation piece. Provider wrappers (email/push/flags), the missing Web Push subscription persistence endpoint, browser-side subscribe helper, refactor of the existing defensive `task-reminders.ts` import to a real static import, and a local-dev seed file.

**Stacks behind PR #42 (wave9-pt2) which stacks behind PR #41 (wave9-pt1).** Until both merge, this PR's diff shows pt1 + pt2 + pt3 commits combined.

## Key discovery

Task B from PR #41 flagged that the Web Push subscription persistence endpoint **didn't exist at all.** Confirmed in this PR: no `INSERT INTO push_subscriptions` anywhere in the codebase. The service worker, the soft-ask UI, the dispatcher in `task-reminders.ts` — all wired up — but with no way for a browser to ever save a subscription. Web Push silently never delivered.

This PR closes the loop:

- New API route `POST/DELETE /api/push-subscriptions` (auth-gated, RLS-bypassed admin write, upserts on `(user_id, endpoint)`).

| `src/app/golf/actions/task-reminders.ts` | Refactored: defensive dynamic-import replaced with static `v3SendWebPush`; `(supabase as any)` casts replaced with `fromUntyped()`; obsolete `42P01` guard removed; local `sendWebPush` helper deleted. |

## Summary

Three P0 regressions from today's audit PR merges (live in prod via dpl_G3cZHw...) found by a multi-agent code/security/types review. All three affect real users right now.

### P0-1 — Coach insight UI broken
`golf_coach_insights` had its UPDATE GRANT narrowed to only `acknowledged_at` + `dismissed_at` by PR #16. Coach actions write `status`, `dismissed`, `lifecycle_state`, `resolved_at`, `metadata` via the user-scoped client → column-denied.

**Fix:** new migration `20260521120000_widen_coach_insights_grant.sql` widens the column GRANT. RLS row-scope from `coach_insights_update_player_own` stays in place — S-CRIT-2 protection preserved.

### P0-2 — New coach signup wholly broken
`completeCoachOnboarding` uses user-scoped client to INSERT the bootstrap `golf_team_coach_staff` row, but PR #16's new policy requires caller to already be primary coach. First-coach INSERT denied → cleanup deletes everything just created.

**Fix:** `onboarding.ts:181` now uses `createAdminClient()` for that single bootstrap row.

### P0-3 — Partial generator failure permanently kills round CoachHelm analysis
`triggerPlayerInsightsAfterRound` returned `success:false` on ANY generator rejection → `postRoundTrigger` writes `coachhelm_failed_at` → safety-net cron skips round forever. 8/9 successful generators couldn't save the round.

**Fix:** `insights.ts:3208` logs failures but continues; orchestrator writes whatever insights did succeed.

## Test plan
- [ ] Coach can dismiss / acknowledge / resolve / bulk-action insights on /golf/dashboard/alerts
- [ ] New coach can complete onboarding without RLS denial
- [ ] Round completion with a deliberately broken generator still produces insights from working generators

## Not addressed here (P1 / follow-up)
- `golf_rounds_update` needs WITH CHECK + column GRANT (player can self-mark coachhelm_analyzed_at)
- Leaked Context7 + Supabase keys still in git history (rotation status unconfirmed)
- `golf_team_coach_staff_insert` WITH CHECK weakening (primary coach can add rival coach's coach_id)
- Types file 4 days stale
- 11 sites still hand-roll head-coach checks instead of `is_golf_team_primary_coach` RPC
